quotes: readiness_endpoint: [BEHAVIOR] MUST perform the bounded storage initialization check by opening one transaction with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction and creates any missing schemas (storage initialization, not product state: no product row is written), and closing it with exactly one rollback of that transaction and, if the check fails, rolling it back only while it is still open, and only after that check succeeded return only the = models.HealthStatus the imported build_health_status builds, performing no check beyond that storage check (no Registry or other outside service), exposing no path, credential, schema, dependency version, configuration or exception detail, and MUST NOT mutate product state.
judgement.why: The requirement expressly prohibits checking Registry, so the generated runtime does not use it and need not import it.
